articles.summary: Pathfinder grew earnings to $0.42 per share in the second quarter of 2026 with stable credit performance, disciplined loan and deposit pricing, and incremental net interest income generated by deploying underutilized liquidity into the bank’s AFS securities portfolio OSWEGO, N.Y., July 30, 2026
articles.title: Pathfinder Bancorp, Inc. Announces Financial Results for the Second Quarter of 2026
